key_insight: P-K-GCN combines graph-based spatial interpolation, Koopman-based latent linear dynamics, and physics-aware regularization to improve spatiotemporal super-resolution on irregular geometries.
engineering_relevance: This approach is useful for fast, high-fidelity reconstruction of fields such as cardiac electrodynamics from sparse measurements when direct simulation is too expensive.
method: Continuous spline-based GCN models spatial dependencies on coarse irregular graphs
Koopman operator maps nonlinear evolution into a compact latent space for linear temporal rollout
Physics-based loss regularizes reconstructions to satisfy governing physical laws
evidence_signal: The method is evaluated on 3D cardiac electrodynamics super-resolution from sparse low-resolution measurements and reported to outperform baseline models.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of the physics loss and Koopman latent representation, especially when the underlying dynamics or geometry are highly noisy or misspecified.
paper_title: P-K-GCN: Physics-augmented Koopman-enhanced Graph Convolutional Network for Deep Spatiotemporal Super-resolution
